name: Juffinger´s Gaumenwerk
kurzbeschreibung:
**Juffinger’s Gaumenwerk in Kufstein**

Discover the art of taste at **Juffinger’s Gaumenwerk**, a culinary gem nestled in the heart of **Kufstein**. Here, traditional Tyrolean flavors meet modern creativity, inviting you to savor the finest local specialties.

Indulge in our signature **Kaiserschmarrn**, a fluffy, caramelized pancake torn into tender pieces and served with apricot compote—a true masterpiece of Austrian pastry art. Pair it with a steaming cup of **Melange** or a glass of crisp **Grüner Veltliner** for the perfect start to your day.

Our menu also features hearty **Tiroler Gröstl**, a rustic dish of crispy potatoes, onions, and fresh herbs, often accompanied by a juicy **Schweinsbraten** (roast pork). For those with a sweet tooth, our selection of homemade **Apfelstrudel** and **Topfenknödel** (quark dumplings) will leave you craving more.

Located just a short stroll from **Kufstein Fortress**, our cozy café offers a warm and welcoming atmosphere, where every bite tells a story of **Tirol’s** rich culinary heritage. Whether you’re exploring the charming old town or taking a break from hiking in the **Kaisergebirge**, **Juffinger’s Gaumenwerk** is the ideal spot to recharge with delicious flavors.

Come and experience **Tirol’s** gastronomic treasures—where tradition meets passion in every dish.
